info.title: SapoClone - sales service
info.description: OpenAPI specification of the sales microservice

amount.description: Integer VND; negative records a refund

shiftId.description:
Cash payments only: the open shift of the order's branch the cash goes into (default: the caller's
own open shift). Ignored for a refund: a refund always leaves the caller's own open shift.

restock.description: Default true: the goods go back on the shelf

qty.description: Positive decimal string with up to 3 decimal places

warehouseId.description: Optional: the sale uses its own branch warehouse; a value must be a BRANCH warehouse of branchId

version.description: Same as `expectedVersion`, under the screen contract's name

orderStatus.description: `confirmed` finalises the draft after the update (reserves stock)

version.description: The order version the client saw (screen contract); a stale one is 409

registerId.description: A register of the branch: its code replaces registerCode and only one open shift is allowed per register

version.description: The shift version the client saw

note.description: Why the drawer must be counted again

plannedEndAt.description: ISO time the shift is planned to end

version.description: The shift version the client saw

actualCash.description: Integer VND. Optional when the drawer was counted with POST /count; a total given here replaces that count

reason.description: Required when the variance is above the tolerance

warehouseId.description: Optional: a sale uses its own branch's warehouse; a value is validated, never trusted (D2)

type.description: Lower-case slug, e.g. `instagram`; a marketplace type belongs to an integration connection
